# Nirooz — Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer

> Full-stack developer specializing in premium UI/UX, high-performance web apps, and business automation. Open to full-time, freelance, and collaborations.

## About
Nirooz is a Full stack engineer and designer crafting modern, high-performance digital experiences. With expertise across frontend and backend development, responsive UI design, and systems architecture, Nirooz builds scalable web applications with a focus on polished aesthetics and speed.
